text:
Situation: Nicardipine hydrochloride is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 222 vials (16.9 days), Corvale General holds 226 vials (15.7 days), and Corvale Lakeside holds 86 vials (27.9 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show nicardipine hydrochloride is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory provides 15.7 to 27.9 days of supply across sites. No FDA shortage listing exists. Proactive sourcing is warranted to prevent future gaps given consumption rates.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase from Caplin Steriles Limited (plant last inspected NAI 2024-08-09); requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Cipla USA Inc. as secondary source (plants last inspected VAI 2023-01-27 and 2024-07-25); requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate Qilu Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (plant last inspected VAI 2023-05-19); requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to assess Sagent Pharmaceuticals and American Regent, Inc. for formulary addition; requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: No immediate clinical protocol changes; inventory supports current demand.
